messages.author: fecbe3dc811bed89
messages.subject: Use nloptr::auglag
parts:
Hi Phil,

Can we use nloptr package rather than Rsolnp and alabama which perform not well to me?

I tried to modify the line 107 of "EMstep.utils.R" that "alabama::constrOptim.nl" was replaced with "nloptr::auglag", but it failed and warned:

Error: Error in .checkfunargs(eval_grad_f, arglist, "eval_grad_f") :
  eval_grad_f requires argument 'optim_args' but this has not been passed to the 'nloptr' function.


Because mirt code is somewhat complex to me, it will be helpful you could show how to add a new optimizer. Thank you.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Use nloptr::auglag
parts:
On Mon, Jun 19, 2017 at 5:57 AM, Keith Lau <genw...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Phil,

Can we use nloptr package rather than Rsolnp and alabama which perform not well to me?
I too have been having difficulty with alabama recently, so perhaps it should just be replaced entirely by the nloptr::auglag function at this point.

I tried to modify the line 107 of "EMstep.utils.R" that "alabama::constrOptim.nl" was replaced with "nloptr::auglag", but it failed and warned:

Error: Error in .checkfunargs(eval_grad_f, arglist, "eval_grad_f") :
  eval_grad_f requires argument 'optim_args' but this has not been passed to the 'nloptr' function.


Because mirt code is somewhat complex to me, it will be helpful you could show how to add a new optimizer. Thank you.

I'm not sure why this error came up. Perhaps the gradient was mis-specified somehow? In any case I'll take a look, and at some point I'll add support for the nloptr() and auglag() functions. Cheers. 

Phil

Phil
